description: Abstract class for processing relation queries within the Thingsboard server, handling entity relation traversal, filtering, and counting logic.

classes.name: AbstractRelationQueryProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class for processing entity relation queries with customizable root entities, direction, level, and filtering logic.

methods.name: getRootEntities
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve root entity IDs for the relation traversal.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the direction of relation search (FROM or TO).

methods.name: getMaxLevel
methods.description: Abstract method to define maximum traversal depth.

methods.name: isFetchLastLevelOnly
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if only last level entities should be fetched.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Abstract method to apply custom filtering on relation info.

methods.name: processQuery
methods.description: Executes the relation query processing, returning a list of sortable entity data.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of entities matching the relation criteria.

methods.name: getEntitiesSet
methods.description: Builds a set of entities by traversing relations starting from root entities.

methods.name: processQuery
methods.description: Processes the relation query, returning sorted entity data based on user context.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts entities matching relation criteria, considering user context.

methods.name: getEntitiesSet
methods.description: Traverses relations to collect entities up to specified depth and filters.
